stories.headline: Huawei unveils 'Tau Scaling Law' to chase 1.4nm-equivalent chips by 2031 without EUV

key_facts.fact: He Tingbo, president of Huawei's semiconductor business and director of its Scientist Committee, presented the Tau (τ) Scaling Law in a keynote titled 'New Semiconductor Path in Practice' at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS) in Shanghai.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS), He Tingbo from HUAWEI delivered a keynote speech titled "New Semiconductor Path in Practice". In her speech, she presented the Tau (τ) Scaling Law, a new principle for guiding the future development of the semiconductor industry.

key_facts.fact: The Tau Scaling Law proposes replacing geometric scaling (shrinking transistors) with 'time scaling' — using τ to denote signal propagation delay — claiming chips that run faster and more efficiently even without the world's most advanced fabrication equipment restricted by US sanctions.
key_facts.excerpt: The Tau Scaling Law proposes replacing geometric scaling with time scaling — using the Greek letter τ (tau) to denote signal propagation delay — as the new guiding principle... instead of building narrower roads, Huawei is shortening the distances signals need to travel.

key_facts.fact: By 2031, Huawei expects the high-end chips it designs using the τ Scaling Law to feature transistor density equivalent to 14 Å (1.4nm) processes — near the projected global frontier that TSMC and Samsung are expected to reach via conventional lithography.
key_facts.excerpt: By 2031, the high-end chips HUAWEI designs based on the τ Scaling Law are expected to feature a transistor density that is equivalent to 14 Å (1.4 nm) processes.

key_facts.fact: Kirin chips scheduled to launch in Fall 2026 will be the first to adopt Huawei's LogicFolding architecture, which shortens critical-path wiring to reduce signal delay; Huawei says it has designed and mass-produced 381 chips based on the τ Scaling Law over the past six years.
key_facts.excerpt: Over the past six years, HUAWEI has designed and mass-produced 381 chips based on the τ Scaling Law... The Kirin chips scheduled to launch in Fall 2026 will be the first ever to adopt the LogicFolding architecture.

key_facts.fact: Chinese semiconductor stocks rallied on the announcement: SMIC jumped more than 17% in Shanghai trading, Cambricon climbed nearly 10%, and Piotech gained over 18%.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp. (SMIC) jumped more than 17% in Shanghai trading. Cambricon Technologies climbed nearly 10%, while Piotech Inc gained over 18%.

key_facts.fact: Huawei released no independent benchmark or manufacturing data; analysts caution that an 'equivalent' 1.4nm density does not match a true 1.4nm-class process from a leading foundry, and Huawei's current Kirin chips are made by SMIC at processes estimated at roughly 7nm.
key_facts.excerpt: The company did not release independent benchmark data or manufacturing metrics confirming the claimed performance levels... manufactured by SMIC using production technologies analysts estimate to be between 7 nm and 5 nm.

stories.headline: Peking University spinout Vifan raises hundreds of millions of yuan for a domestic robot 'brain' chip

key_facts.fact: Beijing Vifan Intelligence Technology, incubated from Peking University's brain-inspired chip lab (PAICORE Lab) and founded in May 2025, has completed a seed round of several hundred million yuan to build a fully domestic 'brain' computing chip for embodied-AI robots.
key_facts.excerpt: 北京维泛智能科技有限公司（以下简称"维泛智能"）近日完成数亿元种子轮融资... 维泛智能成立于2025年5月，孵化自北京大学类脑芯片实验室（PAICORE Lab），专注于具身智能"大小脑"融合芯片研发，致力于打造全国产化机器人核心计算方案。

key_facts.fact: The round was co-led by Zhongguancun Capital and its Qihang Investment arm, with participation from the Shanghai Future Industry Fund, Shixi Capital, Biwin Storage, Yanchuang Group, Haiyi Investment, and Tanyuan Venture.
key_facts.excerpt: 由中关村资本及旗下启航投资联合领投，上海未来产业基金、石溪资本、佰维存储、燕创集团、海益投资、探元创投共同投资。

key_facts.fact: Vifan has developed a Brain-Inspired GPU (BiGPU) architecture that fuses neuromorphic spiking-neural-network computing with general-purpose GPU compute, aiming to cut power use while keeping broad algorithm compatibility for robot perception, AI inference, and motion control.
key_facts.excerpt: 自主研发了类脑启发式GPU架构（Brain-Inpsired GPU，BiGPU)，融合类脑计算与通用GPU计算能力，为具身智能SOTA大模型原生设计。通过引入类脑计算机制降低功耗，同时保留GPU对多种算法框架的通用适配能力。

key_facts.fact: The company is positioning itself as a domestic alternative to Nvidia's Jetson series, which dominates the robot-brain chip market but is described as costly with limited local support; Vifan targets chip production in the second quarter of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: 目前，具身智能"大脑"芯片市场高度依赖英伟达Jetson系列，但存在着价格高昂、本地化支持有限，商业化部署门槛较高问题... 预计于2027年第二季度实现芯片投产。

key_facts.fact: Co-founder Yin Jilei is a Peking University graduate with more than 20 years in semiconductors, previously COO and VP of R&D at Witmem Technology and a chip R&D director at IBM and GlobalFoundries; core team members come from IBM, Huawei, and Tencent.
key_facts.excerpt: 联合创始人殷积磊毕业于北京大学，拥有超过20年半导体行业经验，曾任知存科技COO兼研发副总裁，以及IBM、GlobalFoundries芯片研发总监... 团队核心成员均来自IBM、华为、腾讯等行业头部企业。
